data.one_liner: Show a native webview window on your Flutter desktop application.
data.what_it_does: Opens web pages in native browser windows on macOS, Windows, and Linux. Provides JavaScript bridge communication, navigation controls, cookies management, and window customization.
use_when: You need to display external web pages in native windows from a Flutter desktop app.
You need a cross-platform desktop webview supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
avoid_when: You need to embed a webview widget inline within your normal Flutter widget tree.
You are targeting mobile or web platforms.
strengths: Native window performance and native title bars across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Built-in JavaScript bridge for bi-directional communication with web pages.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific runtime dependencies (such as WebView2 on Windows and WebKitGTK on Linux).
Does not support embedding the webview inline as a standard Flutter widget.
data.setup_notes: Requires installing WebKitGTK and libsoup on Linux, and ensuring the WebView2 Runtime is available on Windows. macOS requires appropriate sandboxing entitlements.
